metadata.title: Cybersecurity Standards for Cloud Systems — Low Impact, Cloud Service Customer

prop.name: certification
prop.value: Self-assessment along with supporting documentation and approval from the highest executive of the organization, the assessment must be retained by the organization and submitted to the office

remarks.p: Low Impact baseline for a Cloud Service Customer (CSC), from the minimum-requirements matrix in clause 4 of the annex.
Selects 19 of the catalog's 39 cloud service customer controls.
Minimum requirements as the matrix states them: Part One: - 5.1.1 and 5.1.2 Part Two: - 5.2.1, 5.2.2, 5.2.3, 5.2.4, 5.2.8, and 5.2.9 *Without 5.2.5

Certification required of the cloud service customer at this level: Self-assessment along with supporting documentation and approval from the highest executive of the organization, the assessment must be retained by the organization and submitted to the office
This profile is a rendering of a published standard and carries no roles or parties: the National Cyber Security Committee issued the standard, not this file.
